overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SEND TEXT command directly sends HTML formatted text data.

constraints: If type is omitted, 4D sends htmlText as MIME type "text/html" (equivalent to WEB SEND BLOB with a TEXT TO BLOB conversion and "text/html" type).
4D does not validate htmlText's HTML encoding; references to 4D variables and 4DSCRIPT tags in the text are always parsed.
